text: Current BatchCompactor uses kRetryDelayMs for the timer delay and kMaxAttempts for its attempt bound, while mQueue, mRetry, mComplete and mFailed name their distinct states. Proposed local naming rule: keep the time unit in the delay name and distinguish attempts from queued folders. This is a source pattern in this scheduler; it is not a project-wide mandate for every constant or container. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Name compaction retry constants by unit and bound
